name: Placeit
description_en:
Placeit is Envato’s browser template generator for product mockups, graphic designs, logos and videos. A user places an existing design into a scene or customizes a template, then downloads a rendered image or video. It is useful for promotional product visuals without building every scene in a layered desktop editor.

A mockup is a representation, not a manufactured sample or print-on-demand fulfillment order. Downloads carry a nonexclusive template license with commercial and merchandising permissions, client-sublicense conditions and restrictions on stock/template redistribution. A subscription’s download allowance does not make template elements exclusive or automatically clear trademarks.
description_zh:
Placeit 是 Envato 的浏览器模板生成工具，覆盖商品样机、图形设计、标志及视频。用户把已有设计放进场景或修改模板，再下载渲染图像/视频，适合无需在分层桌面编辑器从头搭建场景的产品宣传素材。

样机是视觉表示，不是实物样品或按需印刷履约订单。下载附非独占模板许可，包含商业及商品用途，同时有客户转授权条件和图库/模板再分发限制。订阅下载额度不让模板元素独占，也不自动完成商标清权。

core_features.explanation_en: Upload artwork, position/crop it, change product color and download a rendered mockup.
core_features.explanation_zh: 上传图稿、定位/裁切、改产品颜色并下载渲染样机。

core_features.explanation_en: Pricing FAQ lists PNG mockups/designs/logos and MP4 video, rather than promising layered editable source files.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格FAQ列出PNG样机/设计/标志及MP4视频，并未承诺分层可编辑源码。

core_features.explanation_en: License permits end products and merchandising while restricting extraction, stock redistribution and trademark claims over templates.
core_features.explanation_zh: 许可允许成品及商品用途，但限制拆素材、图库再分发及对模板本身主张商标。

sections.title_en: Show the design on a product without ordering the product
sections.title_zh: 展示设计上身效果而非订购商品
sections.en:
Placeit covers apparel, devices, print goods, packaging, branding scenes and video mockups, alongside standalone design and logo templates. The [mockup guide](https://placeit.net/learn/tutorials/how-to-create-mockup) demonstrates inserting artwork into a chosen scene. This is a rendered representation. The pricing FAQ explicitly says Placeit is not a print-on-demand site and does not send physical items.

Editorial example: make listing images for a shirt design or a book cover, selecting a scene that resembles the actual product. Verify blank model, print area, garment color and physical production separately; the vendor’s realism claims do not prove the eventual printed result. This is less suitable when a client needs the full layered scene, unrestricted source assets or an exclusive logo symbol.
sections.zh:
Placeit覆盖服装、设备、印刷品、包装、品牌场景和视频样机，也有独立设计及标志模板。[样机指南](https://placeit.net/learn/tutorials/how-to-create-mockup)演示把图稿放进所选场景，得到的是渲染表示。价格FAQ明确表示Placeit不是按需印刷网站，不寄送实物。

编辑示例：为T恤设计或书封制作商品图，选择接近实物的场景。胚衣型号、印区、颜色及制造效果需另查；厂商真实感宣传不证明最终印品效果。如客户要求完整分层场景、无约束源素材或独占标志符号，则应另外评估。

sections.title_en: Choose the scene, place artwork and inspect the render
sections.title_zh: 选择场景、放置图稿并检查渲染
sections.en:
The guide starts with prepared artwork. Browse Mockups, narrow the category/filters and open a template. In the editor use Design to upload from the device or Placeit downloads, resize/position in live preview and confirm Crop. Change the product color and add optional text/logo, then download. Different template types can expose different controls; the guide is not evidence that every surface, layer or animation is editable.

For a product listing, inspect cropping, margins, transparent areas and whether the scene introduces product claims or third-party marks. The [pricing FAQ](https://placeit.net/pricing) lists PNG for mockups/designs/social posts/logos and MP4 for videos. Those are delivery formats, not proof of SVG, PSD or editable motion source. Keep the original uploaded artwork and verify the actual downloaded dimensions/quality before publishing.
sections.zh:
指南从已准备图稿开始：浏览Mockups，按分类/筛选缩小范围并打开模板，在编辑器用Design从设备或Placeit下载库上传，在实时预览中调整尺寸/位置并确认Crop，再改产品颜色、按需加文字/标志并下载。不同模板控件可能不同，指南不证明每个表面、图层或动画均可编辑。

商品页应检查裁切、边距、透明区，以及场景是否引入产品承诺或第三方标志。[价格FAQ](https://placeit.net/pricing)列出样机/设计/社交帖子/标志为PNG、视频为MP4。这是交付格式，不证明有SVG、PSD或可编辑动态源码。应保留上传原图，发布前检查实际下载尺寸及质量。

sections.title_en: A recurring download subscription and selected free templates
sections.title_zh: 循环下载订阅与部分免费模板
sections.en:
The pricing page advertises unlimited downloads and a “from $7.47/month” offer, but its extracted content also contains other annual-equivalent and discount fragments. The precise selected term, annual charge, regional currency, taxes and promotional renewal rate were not resolved at checkout. This draft therefore preserves the displayed “from” amount as an offer snapshot rather than a normalized universal monthly fee. Free template categories are available; that is not proof the entire library is free or an unlimited free plan.

The FAQ says subscriptions renew each period. If templates have been downloaded, there is a one-month minimum commitment; users who have not downloaded since subscribing are exempt under that wording. It says existing downloads remain accessible after cancellation, while recommending local storage. Canceling future billing and clearing rights for existing products are different questions. No purchase, coupon or cancellation was performed.
sections.zh:
价格页宣传无限下载及“每月$7.47起”，提取内容同时有其他年付折合和折扣片段。未在结账核实选中账期、年度扣款、区域币种、税费和优惠续费率，因此本文把“起”数额保留为报价快照，不作为统一标准月费。网站有免费模板分类，不证明全部图库免费或存在无限免费方案。

FAQ表示订阅每期自动续费；订阅后下载过模板则最低承诺一个月，未下载用户按其措辞可豁免。取消后已有下载仍可访问，但建议本地保存。取消未来账单与已有产品权利清晰是不同问题。本文未购买、用券或取消。

sections.title_en: Commercial use is nonexclusive and product-scoped
sections.title_zh: 商业用途非独占且围绕成品
sections.en:
The [March 11, 2025 license](https://placeit.net/license) grants a worldwide nonexclusive revocable right, subject to payment and compliance, to customize templates and use resulting products. It permits commercial products and merchandising, and multiple end products from one customized product. For a client, sublicense the template only as necessary for that end product and communicate the license conditions; the client may not extract it for unrelated use.

The license prohibits redistribution as stock/tools/templates, as-is or superficial redistribution, and making the template available for end-user customization through on-demand services. That restriction differs from selling a finished merchandise product. It permits applying for a trademark only under stated conditions, including added standard characters and no claim over the template itself; registration is not warranted because other users can make similar designs. A logo download is not exclusive brand ownership.
sections.zh:
[2025年3月11日许可](https://placeit.net/license)在付费及遵守条件下，授予全球非独占、可撤销的模板定制及成品使用权，允许商业成品、商品用途及由同一定制产品制作多个成品。客户交接只能就使用该成品所必需的模板部分转授权，并告知条件，客户不得拆出作其他用途。

许可禁止作为图库/工具/模板分发、原样或仅表面修改后分发，以及通过按需服务开放模板供最终用户定制。这与销售完成的商品不同。商标申请仅在指定条件下允许，包括添加标准字符且不主张模板本身权利；因其他用户可做相似设计，厂商不保证注册成功。下载标志不等于独占品牌所有权。

sections.title_en: Template permissions do not clear every pictured brand or asset
sections.title_zh: 模板许可不清除所有场景品牌及素材权利
sections.en:
The license warns that some components have third-party/open-source/Creative Commons terms and that third-party product names/images may be illustrative without clearance for the user. Users must obtain required permissions. Model images also have restrictions around false identity, endorsement and sensitive/defamatory uses. Your uploads remain yours, while the underlying templates remain the provider’s or licensors’ property.

Keep the license/download record for the actual output and identify any third-party component before a large campaign. The software platform’s own distribution/source license was not established from this template agreement. No upload, render download, client sublicense, trademark clearance, printing or long-term access test was executed; visual examples are not evidence of measured sales or conversion improvements.
sections.zh:
许可提示部分组件适用第三方、开源或Creative Commons条款，第三方产品名称/图像可能仅作示意，并未替用户清权，所需授权由用户取得。模特图像还限制虚假身份、代言及敏感/诽谤用途。上传内容仍归用户，底层模板仍归提供方或许可人。

应保留实际输出的许可/下载记录，大型活动前识别第三方组件。该模板协议未建立平台软件自身的分发/源码许可。本文未执行上传、渲染下载、客户转授权、商标清权、印刷或长期访问测试，视觉例子不证明销售或转化提升。
